s: In which Budget was the 11% cotton import duty, withdrawn in August 2025, introduced?
x: The 11% duty was introduced in Union Budget 2021 to protect cotton farmers.

s: Which of the following cotton-related pairs is correctly matched?
o: 2021 production and requirement – 294 and 318 lakh bales
2024-25 production and requirement – 350 and 335 lakh bales
x: About six million farmers grow cotton; 2024-25 production and requirement were 294 and 318 lakh bales, and 2021 figures were 350 and 335 lakh bales.

s: To about what size had India's bioeconomy, $10 billion in 2014, grown by 2024?
x: The bioeconomy reached $165.7 billion in 2024, about 4.25% of GDP.

s: After the recovery of Andhra Pradesh's seafood exports to the United States, what trade measure was called for to support the sector?
o: A continuation of anti-dumping and countervailing duties
A permanent halt to seafood exports to the United States
A reduction in aqua-product shipments to the United States
A free trade agreement with the United States
x: The demand was for a free trade agreement with the United States. The other options do not represent the trade measure called for after the recovery of exports.

s: Which description best characterises India's position in the global dairy sector?
o: The world's largest milk producer, based on a government-owned dairy model
The world's largest milk producer, based on large-scale, pasture-based dairies
The world's second-largest milk producer, based on a smallholder, cooperative-led model
The world's largest milk producer, based on a smallholder, cooperative-led model
x: India is the largest milk producer in the world, and its dairy system is smallholder and cooperative-led. The large-scale pasture-based description is associated with the New Zealand-style model, which India cannot adopt because it lacks sufficient land for such pasture dairying.

s: Which of the following is NOT correct about India's dairy sector?
o: Its competitiveness comes from low labour costs.
India lacks land for New Zealand-style pasture dairying.
Its competitiveness comes from high yields per cow.
x: India's competitiveness comes from low labour costs, not high yields per cow.

s: Which of the following is NOT correct about India's green economy?
o: India is projected to have 35 million green jobs by 2030
The landscape approach is associated with 2 lakh PRIs
Women hold only 11% of rooftop solar jobs
x: The PRI figure linked to the landscape approach is 2.5 lakh, not 2 lakh.

s: Following the earlier 25% tariff on shrimp, what change was reported in shrimp prices in Andhra Pradesh?
x: Shrimp prices in Andhra Pradesh fell by approximately 20% after the earlier 25% tariff. The 25% figure refers to the tariff, not the decline in shrimp prices.

s: According to the comparison of dairy-sector indicators, what is India’s annual yield per cow?
x: India’s yield per cow is 1.64 tonnes per year. The other figures are the yields given for New Zealand, the European Union and the United States respectively.

s: Under PM-eBus Sewa, how many fully air-conditioned e-buses were allocated to Andhra Pradesh?
x: Andhra Pradesh got 750 fully AC e-buses under PM-eBus Sewa, run through PPP in Tier-2 and Tier-3 cities.

s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the Smart Cities Mission in Andhra Pradesh?
o: The completed projects are worth ₹6,200 crore.
Over 84% of the projects have been completed.
The progress covers Amaravati, Kakinada, Tirupati and Visakhapatnam.
₹6,200 crore is the value of AMRUT project DPRs.
x: The completed Smart Cities projects are worth ₹5,701 crore; ₹6,200 crore is the value of AMRUT DPRs.

s: What rank did Andhra Pradesh get among major States under PM SVANidhi, achieving 103.08% of its target?
x: Andhra Pradesh ranked 3rd among major States and covered over 3.3 lakh street vendors.

s: What is China's MIIT campaign against EV-sector price wars called?
x: China’s response included a draft Pricing Law overhaul, orderly exit of capacity and the MIIT’s ‘war on price wars’.

s: What support do the Department of Commerce and APEDA give the Bharat International Rice Conference 2025?
x: The Department of Commerce and APEDA give BIRC 2025 non-financial support only.

s: What was the value of India's rice exports, its largest agricultural export, in FY 2024-25?
x: India's rice exports in FY 2024–25 were worth US$12.95 billion.

s: Which country was India’s largest seafood export destination in 2023–24, receiving 2,97,571 MT?
x: The United States was the largest destination, with a 34.53% share; Andhra Pradesh’s own share of India’s seafood exports was about 33%.

s: In which year was India's Agriculture Export Policy introduced?
x: The Agriculture Export Policy dates to 2018; 1985 is the year of the APEDA Act.

s: Which State's aqua-product shipments to the US were halted within 24 hours of the 26% US tariff announcement?
x: Andhra Pradesh's aqua-product shipments to the US were halted within 24 hours of the 26% tariff announcement.

s: Which competing seafood exporter faced only a 10% US tariff, compared with Indian aqua exports?
x: Ecuador faced only a 10% tariff.

s: Which district was NOT among those where Andhra Pradesh's seafood-export activity revived after the 90-day tariff pause?
x: Activity revived in Eluru, Krishna, East and West Godavari, Nellore and Prakasam, but not Guntur.

s: Women hold what share of rooftop solar jobs in India?
x: Women hold only 11% of rooftop solar jobs.

s: Indian dairy farmers receive what share of the retail price of milk?
x: Indian farmers get 55–57% of the retail milk price, against 35% in the US.

s: Which Andhra Pradesh metro project was reported to be about 38 km long?
x: The Vijayawada Metro was reported to be about 38 km long.

s: Under which Act was APEDA set up?
x: APEDA was set up under the APEDA Act, 1985, operative from 13 February 1986.

s: From what does the competitiveness of Indian dairy mainly come?
o: A pasture-based model like New Zealand's
x: Indian dairy is competitive because of low labour costs, not high yields; it is smallholder and cooperative-led.

s: What level of ethanol blending in petrol has India achieved?
x: India has achieved 20% ethanol blending.

s: Who coined the term 'involution' in 1969 in his work 'Agricultural Involution'?
x: Anthropologist Clifford Geertz coined 'involution' in 1969, studying wet-rice farming in Java.

s: About what share of India's seafood exports comes from Andhra Pradesh?
x: Andhra Pradesh accounts for about 33% of India's seafood exports.

s: Which of the following is correct about the Agricultural and Processed Food Products Export Development Authority (APEDA)?
o: It works under the Ministry of Agriculture
It was set up under an Act of 1995
It works under the Ministry of Commerce and runs the NPOP
x: APEDA, set up under the APEDA Act, 1985, works under the Ministry of Commerce, is headquartered in New Delhi and runs the National Programme for Organic Production.

s: Who chaired the 56th GST Council meeting held on 3 September 2025, which approved the GST 2.0 changes?
x: Nirmala Sitharaman chaired the 56th GST Council meeting held on 3 September 2025. Arvind Shrivastava was the Revenue Secretary, while Samrat Choudhary and Suresh Khanna were associated with the decision as representatives from Bihar and Uttar Pradesh.

s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the GST 2.0 restructuring?
o: Sin and demerit goods such as cigarettes and paan masala attract 40%.
The 12% and 28% slabs were retained along with 5% and 18%.
The new 5% and 18% slabs took effect on 22 September 2025.
Compensation cess on tobacco continues until the loans are repaid.
x: The 12% and 28% slabs were dropped; 0%, 5% and 18% remain with a 40% demerit rate.

s: Which of the following was an economic implication of the GST 2.0 restructuring?
o: Correction of the inverted duty structure
Introduction of an inverted duty structure
x: GST 2.0 included correction of the inverted duty structure.

s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the GST 2.0 restructuring?
o: GST rates were changed for 546 goods
Exempt goods do not provide Input Tax Credit
Over 80% of the affected goods saw rate cuts
The shift from 28% to 40% for some goods was a real increase in tax burden in every case
x: The 28% to 40% movement reflected the merger of compensation cess and was not a real hike in every case.

s: About how much revenue was estimated to be foregone from the 2025 GST changes together with the income-tax reforms?
x: The estimate was about ₹1 lakh crore; the PM described the changes as the “GST Bachat Utsav”.

s: Under the GST changes effective 22 September 2025, which of the following attracts zero GST?
o: Non-ICU hospital rooms above ₹5,000 per day
x: Individual health and life insurance and reinsurance were given zero GST.

s: Which of the following is NOT correct about GST 2.0 (effective 22 September 2025)?
x: Life-saving cancer drugs were placed under Nil GST, not 5%; individual health insurance and reinsurance are also Nil.

s: What GST do cigarettes attract under the changes of 22 September 2025?
x: Cigarettes attract 28% GST plus cess, an effective burden of 52–88%; they were not moved to a plain 40% slab.

s: Which of the following is NOT correct about GST on health care from 22 September 2025?
o: Non-ICU rooms above ₹5,000 per day attract 18% GST without ITC.
ICU, CCU, ICCU and NICU rooms are exempt.
Hospital rooms below ₹5,000 per day are exempt.
Individual health insurance attracts Nil GST.
x: Non-ICU rooms above ₹5,000 per day attract 5% GST without ITC, not 18%.

s: With whom does the final decision on GST rate rationalisation rest?
o: The Group of Ministers chaired by Samrat Choudhary
The GST Council chaired by the Union Finance Minister
x: The Group of Ministers only accepted the Centre's proposal; the final say lies with the GST Council chaired by the Union Finance Minister.

s: For which goods was the new 40% GST slab proposed under the rate rationalisation?
o: Sin goods such as tobacco, cigarettes and online real-money gaming
x: The 40% slab was for sin goods such as tobacco, cigarettes and online real-money gaming.

s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the proposed GST rate rationalisation?
o: The average effective GST rate is expected to rise from about 10% to about 11.5%
GST was introduced in 2017 with slabs of 5%, 12%, 18% and 28%, along with cess
The 18% slab accounts for about 70% of GST revenue
x: The average effective GST rate is expected to fall from about 11.5% to about 10%, not rise.

s: Which group of States was identified as more affected by the proposed GST rate rationalisation, with an earlier rate cut associated with a 3–4% monthly dip?
o: Bihar, Uttar Pradesh and the North-East
x: Manufacturing and service States such as Maharashtra, Karnataka and Tamil Nadu were identified as more affected. The earlier rate cut was associated with a 3–4% monthly dip; Bihar, Uttar Pradesh and the North-East were identified as less affected agrarian regions.

s: How does the GST Council generally take its decisions?
o: Decision of the Union Finance Minister
x: The GST Council works by consensus, and voting is rare.

s: India's insurance penetration was what share of GDP, against the world figure of 6.8%?
x: India's insurance penetration was 3.7% of GDP, compared with 6.8% globally.

s: When did the original GST compensation to States, given for five years from July 2017, end?
x: The compensation arrangement ran for 5 years from July 2017 through the compensation cess and ended in June 2022.

s: Which GST slabs were abolished under GST 2.0?
x: GST 2.0 kept 0, 5 and 18% and added 40%; the 12% and 28% slabs were abolished.

s: What does the move of some goods from 28% to 40% under GST 2.0 mainly reflect?
o: A real increase in the tax burden
The merger of the compensation cess
A new levy shared only with States
x: The jump from 28% to 40% shows the compensation cess being merged into the rate, not a real hike.

s: What GST do non-ICU hospital rooms above ₹5,000 per day attract from 22 September 2025?
x: Non-ICU rooms above ₹5,000/day attract 5% GST without input tax credit; rooms below ₹5,000 are exempt.

s: What name did PM Modi give to the GST 2.0 rate cuts?
x: PM Modi called the GST 2.0 changes "GST Bachat Utsav".

s: Which GST slab, kept unchanged, gives about 70% of GST revenue?
x: The 18% slab yields about 70% of GST revenue and was kept.

s: Which meeting of the GST Council, held on 3 September 2025, approved GST 2.0?
x: The 56th GST Council meeting on 3 September 2025 approved the new 0/5/18/40% structure.

s: Who chaired the Group of Ministers on GST rate rationalisation?
x: The GoM on rate rationalisation was chaired by Bihar Deputy CM Samrat Choudhary.

s: In which year was GST introduced in India?
x: GST was introduced in 2017 with slabs of 5, 12, 18 and 28 per cent.

s: What was India's CPI inflation in September 2025, a 99-month low?
x: September 2025 CPI inflation was 1.54%; 2.2% was the H1 FY26 average and 2.6% the RBI’s September forecast.

s: What monthly inflation rate is generally associated with hyperinflation in the background discussion of inflation?
x: Hyperinflation is defined here as inflation exceeding 50% per month. The 4% ± 2% figure refers to the flexible inflation target, not the hyperinflation threshold.

s: By how much did the US Federal Reserve cut its policy rate ahead of the RBI MPC meeting of 29 September–1 October 2025?
x: The US Fed cut its rate by 25 bps to 4–4.25%, its first cut of 2025.

s: What was the FY26 GDP projection cited in the RBI MPC preview?
x: The FY26 GDP projection was 6.5%.

s: Which US tariff on Indian goods was cited in the RBI MPC preview for 29 September–1 October 2025?
x: The US tariff on Indian goods cited was 50%.

s: To what level did the RBI cut the Cash Reserve Ratio in June 2025, by 100 bps?
x: On 6 June 2025 the CRR was cut 100 bps to 3% in stages, along with a 50 bps repo cut.

s:
Consider the following statements about the RBI MPC decision of 6 June 2025:
1. The repo rate was cut by 50 bps to 5.50%.
2. The stance changed from neutral to accommodative.
3. The MSF rate and Bank Rate were set at 5.75%.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
x: Statements 1 and 3 are correct; the stance changed from accommodative to neutral, not the other way round.

s: How many members does the RBI Monetary Policy Committee have, including the Governor?
x: The MPC has six members including the RBI Governor.

s: At what level did the RBI project FY26 CPI inflation at its 29 September–1 October 2025 meeting?
x: The RBI cut its FY26 CPI forecast to 2.6%; 3.1% was the August forecast and 4% the April one.

s: What is the RBI's CPI inflation target under Flexible Inflation Targeting?
x: The inflation target is 4% with a band of ±2%.

s: What was India's GDP growth in Q1 FY26 (April–June 2025), the highest in five quarters?
x: Q1 FY26 real GDP grew 7.8%; 8.8% was nominal GDP growth and 6.5% the figure a year earlier.

s: By how many basis points in total did the RBI cut the repo rate between February and June 2025, bringing it to 5.5%?
x: The RBI cut the repo rate by a total of 100 bps from February to June 2025, to 5.5%.

s: Which survey is MoSPI scheduled to conduct across India from February 2026?
x: MoSPI will conduct India's first pan-India National Household Income Survey from February 2026; the debt and situation surveys are for July 2026–June 2027.

s: Who is the MoSPI Secretary associated with India's first National Household Income Survey?
x: Saurabh Garg is the Secretary of MoSPI.

s: Which ministry is scheduled to conduct the All-India Debt and Investment Survey and the Situation Assessment Survey during July 2026–June 2027?
o: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation
x: MoSPI (Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation) is scheduled to conduct both the All-India Debt and Investment Survey and the Situation Assessment Survey of Agricultural Households during July 2026–June 2027.

s: At which level is Uttar Pradesh's Women's Economic Empowerment Index India's first such index?
x: Uttar Pradesh has India's first district-level Women's Economic Empowerment Index.

s: What unemployment rate (age 15+) did the first monthly PLFS bulletin, for April 2025, report?
x: MoSPI's first monthly PLFS bulletin, released 15 May 2025, showed 5.1% unemployment.

s: Who compiles the Wholesale Price Index (WPI) in India?
o: The Office of the Economic Adviser, DPIIT
x: WPI, like the Index of Eight Core Industries, is compiled by the Office of the Economic Adviser, DPIIT.

s: What was the base year of the Index of Industrial Production (IIP) in April–November 2025?
x: The IIP used base year 2011-12 in this period.

s: At what rate did the IMF (World Economic Outlook, October 2025) project India's FY26 growth?
x: The IMF raised its FY26 projection by 20 bps to 6.6%.

s: Which of the following pairs (agency – FY26 growth projection for India, October 2025) is correctly matched?
x: The World Bank projected 6.5%; the RBI said 6.8%, the IMF 6.6% and the ADB 6.5%.

s: Who compiles the Index of Eight Core Industries?
o: Office of the Economic Adviser, DPIIT
x: The Index of Eight Core Industries is compiled by the Office of the Economic Adviser, DPIIT.

s: Which Ministry released India's first monthly PLFS bulletin on 15 May 2025?
o: Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation
x: MoSPI released the first monthly PLFS bulletin (for April 2025) on 15 May 2025.

s: What is the base year of the Wholesale Price Index (WPI) series in use during April–November 2025?
x: The WPI, compiled by the Office of the Economic Adviser, DPIIT, has the base year 2011-12.

s: In which year was the Situation Assessment Survey (SAS) of Agricultural Households first launched?
x: MoSPI's Situation Assessment Survey of Agricultural Households was first launched in 2003.

s: By which year is India targeting a $30 trillion economy?
x: The stated target is a $30 trillion economy by 2047.

s: Along with US reciprocal tariffs, which terror attack was identified as a 2025 trigger for rethinking South Asian economic integration?
x: The 2025 triggers were the Pahalgam terror attack and US reciprocal tariffs; the suggestions were to revive SAARC summits and pursue the BBIN Motor Vehicle Agreement.

s: Which of the following is NOT correct about South Asian trade integration?
o: Intra-regional trade under SAFTA is only 5–7% of total trade.
SAARC trade is $23 billion against a potential of $67 billion.
Intra-SAARC trade costs are 114% of goods value, against 109% for trade with the US.
Bangladesh has the highest unexploited trade potential, at 86%.
x: Bangladesh's unexploited trade potential is 93%; 86% is the overall unexploited potential.

s: About how large was India's record goods trade deficit in October 2025?
x: The goods trade deficit was about USD 42 billion; USD 76 billion was the record level of imports.

s: Who holds and who owns India's foreign-exchange reserves?
o: Held and owned by the Government of India
Held and owned by the RBI
Held by the RBI and owned by the Government of India
Held by the Government of India and owned by the RBI
x: The reserves are held by the RBI but owned by the Government of India.

s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the rupee's weakness in 2025?
o: FPI selling added to the rupee's weakness
The unwinding of the Japanese yen carry trade added to it
The RBI targets a fixed level of the rupee
The RBI extended export-proceeds realisation from 9 to 15 months
x: The RBI follows a managed float: it curbs volatility but does not target a rupee level. The other three statements are correct.

s: Which of the following pairs is INCORRECTLY matched?
o: NEER – Rupee against a currency basket without inflation adjustment
Rise in NEER – Appreciation of the rupee
Rise in REER – Gain in competitiveness
x: A rise in REER indicates a loss of competitiveness, not a gain.

s: What does a trade deficit measure?
o: Goods and services imports minus exports
Goods imports minus goods exports only
x: The trade deficit covers goods only; the current account deficit adds services, income and transfers.

s: On which date did the rupee hit its all-time low of ₹89.41 per US dollar?
x: The rupee touched ₹89.41/USD on 21 November 2025 before rebounding.

s: What is the RBI's approach to the rupee, curbing volatility without targeting a level, called?
x: The RBI follows a managed float: it does not target an exchange-rate level and instead curbs volatility.

s: What does a rise in the Real Effective Exchange Rate (REER) indicate?
x: REER is inflation-adjusted; a rise means a loss of competitiveness.

s: Which South Asian country has the highest unexploited intra-regional trade potential, at 93%?
x: Over 86% of South Asia's trade potential is unexploited, with Bangladesh highest at 93%.

s: Which country was India's largest trading partner in 2024-25?
x: The USA stayed India's largest trading partner for the fourth year in a row, with trade of $131.84 billion.

s: With which country did India have a record trade deficit of about $99.2 billion in 2024-25?
x: China was India's second-largest trading partner, and India's trade deficit with it widened to a record $99.2 billion.

s: Which of the following is an example of intra-industry trade?
o: India exports rice and imports crude oil
India exports cars and also imports cars
India exports tea and imports machinery
India exports iron ore and imports gold
x: Intra-industry trade is the export and import of goods of the same industry at the same time, such as cars.

s: Which index is commonly used to measure intra-industry trade?
x: The Grubel-Lloyd index is the most common measure of intra-industry trade.

s: Which is the largest component of India's foreign-exchange reserves?
x: Foreign Currency Assets form the largest part of India's forex reserves.

s: To how many months did the RBI extend the period for realising export proceeds, from 9 months?
x: Amid the rupee's fall, the RBI extended export proceeds realisation from 9 to 15 months.

s: About how large were India's foreign-exchange reserves around November 2025?
x: India's forex reserves were about USD 690 billion when the rupee hit its record low in November 2025.

s: Which set of industrial hubs was identified as being hit by the US tariff increase on Indian exports?
o: Andhra Pradesh, Kerala, Uttar Pradesh and the North-East
Maharashtra, Karnataka, Tamil Nadu and Bihar
x: The identified hubs were Tiruppur, Noida–Gurugram, Ludhiana and Bengaluru. The other options combine States or places mentioned in separate GST and sector-specific contexts.

s: Which RBI Governor was reported ready with liquidity support amid the tariff-related disruption?
x: RBI Governor Sanjay Malhotra was reported to be ready with liquidity support.

s: In the India–US trade talks of June 2025, which issues were the principal sticking points?
x: Agriculture and dairy were the main sticking points, over small producers and hormones in US milk.

s: In which year did the US withdraw India's GSP status?
x: The US withdrew India's GSP status in 2019; 9 July 2025 was only the reciprocal-tariff deadline.

s: Which of the following pairs (sector – US tariff change) is correctly matched?
x: Shrimp went from 10% to 60%; jewellery 2.1% to 52.1%, carpets 2.9% to 52.9% and organic chemicals 4% to 54%.

s: Which response was suggested for Indian sectors affected by the US tariff increase?
o: Retaining dependence on the United States and abolishing FTAs
Diversifying markets and pursuing FTAs with the UAE, Australia and EFTA
Introducing a compensation cess for all exports to the United States
Restricting exports to the UAE, Australia and EFTA
x: The suggested response was to diversify markets and pursue FTAs with the UAE, Australia and EFTA. The other options reverse or alter the stated strategy.

s: Among sectors hit by the US 50% tariff, which has the highest US share of India's exports (58.6%)?
x: Carpets have the highest US share (58.6%); organic chemicals' share is only 13.2%.

s: What do 'digital arrest' frauds involve?
o: Remote access to the victim’s device
x: Digital arrests involve impersonating police or customs officials; phishing, remote access and mule accounts are other fraud methods.

s: What position did Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman express regarding crypto assets such as stablecoins?
o: India must be ready to engage with them
India must use them only for domestic retail payments
India must replace all bank deposits with them
India must restrict engagement to Bitcoin alone
x: Nirmala Sitharaman said that India must be ready to engage with crypto assets such as stablecoins. The statement did not limit engagement to Bitcoin or propose replacing bank deposits with stablecoins.

s: In August 2025, what did SEBI propose to replace the grey market for trading shares before IPO listing?
o: A ban on transfer of IPO allotments
A regulated venue for pre-listing trading
A SEBI-run grey market price index
x: SEBI proposed a regulated venue for trading shares before IPO listing to replace the grey market.

s: What is the European Union's regulatory framework for stablecoins called?
x: The EU regulates stablecoins under MiCA; the US counterpart is the GENIUS Act.

s: What expiry do equity derivatives in India currently have?
x: Equity derivatives currently have weekly and monthly expiry, with longer tenure proposed.

s: In the IPO grey market, what is the premium for selling IPO application rights called?
x: The Kostak rate is the premium paid for selling IPO application rights in the grey market. The Grey Market Premium (GMP) is a different grey-market term.

s: Which foreign investor agreed to acquire 60% of RBL Bank for $3 billion?
x: Emirates NBD of Dubai agreed to acquire 60% of RBL Bank for $3 billion. Blackstone invested in Federal Bank, SMBC in Yes Bank, and Fairfax secured a majority in CSB Bank for five years.

s: Which entity acquired 25% of Yes Bank for $1.6 billion?
x: SMBC acquired 25% of Yes Bank; Blackstone took 9.99% of Federal Bank and Zurich took 70% of Kotak General Insurance.

s: In the context of cyber frauds affecting India's digital economy, what does the 24-hour window refer to?
o: The recovery window for attempting to recover fraudulent funds
A statutory RBI mandate to freeze every suspicious account
The time limit for completing KYC of mule accounts
The deadline for reporting every UPI transaction to RBI
x: The 24-hour window refers to the recovery window in cyber-fraud cases. There was no statutory RBI mandate requiring a 24-hour freeze at the time described.

s: What are the FDI caps identified for insurance and private banks, respectively, in the context of global capital in Indian financial institutions?
x: The stated FDI caps are 100% for insurance and 74% for private banks. The reversed pair incorrectly assigns the banking cap to insurance and the insurance cap to private banks.

s: Which of the following is a crypto-backed stablecoin?
x: DAI is crypto-backed (by Ethereum); USDT and USDC are fiat-backed and TerraUSD was algorithmic.

s: Which pair represents consensus mechanisms associated with blockchain networks?
o: Proof of Work and Proof of Stake
x: Proof of Work (PoW) and Proof of Stake (PoS) are consensus mechanisms used in blockchain networks. Public, private and consortium refer to blockchain types, while Bitcoin, Ethereum and Hyperledger are examples of blockchain platforms or networks.

s: Which commodity derivatives did SEBI propose to open to FPIs?
o: Non-cash-settled, non-agricultural derivatives such as gold and silver
x: The proposal covers non-cash-settled, non-agricultural commodity derivatives (gold, silver, zinc, lead), not agricultural ones.

s: Which of the following was included in SEBI's proposal for foreign portfolio investors?
o: An approval-only route with no automatic window
x: The proposal specified a single automatic window for foreign investors, not two.

s: At the Global Fintech Fest (October 2025), what did NPCI enable for UPI payments?
o: Biometric authentication instead of a PIN
x: NPCI enabled UPI payments by fingerprint or face authentication instead of a PIN.

s: Which of the following is NOT among NPCI's announcements at the Global Fintech Fest, Mumbai (October 2025)?
o: A statutory 24-hour freeze mandate on stolen funds
x: There is no statutory 24-hour freeze mandate; the 24-hour window is only the recovery window for stolen funds.

s: Blackstone agreed to acquire 9.99% of which bank for ₹6,196 crore?
x: Blackstone took 9.99% of Federal Bank; Emirates NBD took RBL Bank and SMBC took Yes Bank.

s: Whose signature do the new ₹20 banknotes in the Mahatma Gandhi (New) Series, announced by the RBI in May 2025, bear?
x: The RBI said on 17 May 2025 that new ₹20 notes would carry the signature of Governor Sanjay Malhotra.

s:
Consider the following statements about the new ₹20 banknotes announced by the RBI in May 2025:
1. They bear the signature of Governor Sanjay Malhotra.
2. The ₹20 notes issued earlier have ceased to be legal tender.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
x: Only the signature changes; all earlier ₹20 notes remain legal tender, so statement 2 is wrong.

s: Who was the SEBI Chairperson when SEBI announced a regulated venue for pre-listing trades in August 2025?
x: SEBI Chairperson Tuhin Kanta Pandey announced it at FICCI on 21 August 2025.

s: Which company agreed to acquire 70% of Kotak General Insurance for about $670 million?
x: Zurich Insurance agreed to buy 70% of Kotak General Insurance for about $670 million.

s: Which digital-economy target was linked to the cyber-fraud concerns highlighted in October 2025?
x: The target is a US$1 trillion digital economy by 2030.

s: Who launched the 'Your Capital, Your Right' campaign on 4 October 2025?
x: Nirmala Sitharaman launched it on 4 October 2025 in Gandhinagar; RBI, SEBI and PFRDA were partners.

s: About how much were the unclaimed mutual funds identified by the Department of Financial Services in August 2025?
x: Unclaimed mutual funds were about ₹3,000 crore; unpaid dividends exceeded ₹9,000 crore and unclaimed deposits ₹75,000 crore.

s: Which body led the 'Your Capital, Your Right' campaign (October–December 2025)?
x: The campaign was led by the Department of Financial Services and followed the 3 A's: Awareness, Accessibility and Action.

s: About 172 crore unclaimed shares have been moved to which fund?
x: About 172 crore shares were moved to the IEPF; total identified unclaimed assets exceeded ₹1 lakh crore.

s: What was the EPF interest rate fixed for 2024-25?
x: The EPFO board fixed 8.25% for 2024-25, the same as 2023-24.

s: What interest rate was kept on Sukanya Samriddhi for October–December 2025?
x: Small-savings rates were unchanged: Sukanya Samriddhi 8.2%, NSC 7.7%, PPF 7.1%.

s: What does the '3 A's' strategy of the 'Your Capital, Your Right' campaign stand for?
x: The DFS-led campaign follows the 3 A's: Awareness, Accessibility, Action.

s: What was the interest rate on the Public Provident Fund (PPF) for October–December 2025?
x: Small savings rates were unchanged; PPF stayed at 7.1%.

s: Unclaimed bank deposits of over ₹75,000 crore have been transferred to which fund of the RBI?
x: Unclaimed bank deposits go to the RBI's Depositor Education and Awareness (DEA) Fund; unclaimed shares go to the IEPF.

s: Where was the 'Your Capital, Your Right' campaign launched on 4 October 2025?
x: Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman launched the campaign at Gandhinagar, Gujarat, on 4 October 2025.

s: A draft Quality Control Order is hosted on the WTO website of which Agreement?
x: Draft QCOs are hosted on the WTO TBT website, and six months is usually given for compliance.

s: Which of the following is NOT correct regarding the effects of Quality Control Orders?
o: Room air conditioner output rose from about 1 million to 12 million
Birla Aircon, Meerut saw turnover rise from ₹7 crore to ₹42 crore
Hermetic compressor output rose from less than 2 million to 12 million
NITI Aayog Vice Chairman Suman Berry described QCOs as a “malign intervention”
x: Hermetic compressor output rose from less than 2 million to 8 million; the rise to 12 million was in room air conditioners.

s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the approved rail multi-tracking projects?
o: They are to be completed by 2031-32.
They cover four sections across Maharashtra, Madhya Pradesh, Gujarat and Chhattisgarh.
They come under the PM Gati Shakti National Master Plan.
x: The projects are to be completed by 2030-31, not 2031-32.

s: The Gondia–Dongargarh railway multi-tracking section covers which States?
x: Gondia–Dongargarh covers Maharashtra and Chhattisgarh, while Itarsi–Bhopal–Bina is in Madhya Pradesh.

s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the approved rail multi-tracking projects and PM Gati Shakti?
o: Sanchi is among the associated tourism destinations
India's logistics cost is about 13% of GDP
The projects come under the PM Gati Shakti National Master Plan
Satpura Tiger Reserve is not among the associated tourism destinations
x: Satpura Tiger Reserve, like Sanchi, is among the tourism destinations associated with the projects.

s: Under the PM E-DRIVE scheme, what amount was earmarked for EV charging infrastructure?
x: ₹2,000 crore was earmarked for EV charging infrastructure (about 72,300 fast chargers) under PM E-DRIVE, whose total outlay is ₹10,900 crore. ₹10,000 crore was the FAME-II outlay, not the charging allocation.

s: Which section of the BIS Act, 2016 enables the government to make the Standard Mark compulsory through Quality Control Orders?
x: Section 16 is the legal basis for compulsory use of the Standard Mark; most of the ~23,000 BIS standards are otherwise voluntary.

s: Which is the nodal ministry for PM E-DRIVE, whose September 2025 guidelines offer up to 100% subsidy for EV charging stations?
o: Ministry of Road Transport and Highways
Ministry of New and Renewable Energy
x: The Ministry of Heavy Industries is the nodal ministry for PM E-DRIVE.

s: Under the PM E-DRIVE guidelines for EV charging infrastructure, which of the following is included among the priority locations?
o: Only villages with a population below 1 million
Cities with a population exceeding 1 million according to Census 2011
Only the seven metropolitan cities and no satellite towns
Only State capitals and no highways
x: Cities with a population exceeding 1 million as per Census 2011 are among the priority locations. The priority list also includes smart cities, satellite towns of seven metros, State capitals, NCAP cities and highways, so the restrictive alternatives are incorrect.

s: For the phase 1 Musi Riverfront Development Project in Telangana, what loan amount did the Centre clear from the Asian Development Bank (ADB)?
x: The Centre cleared an Asian Development Bank loan of ₹4,100 crore for phase 1 of the Musi Riverfront Development Project. The other figures are linked to different parts of the project: 20 TMCFT of water, and 250 acres of Defence land sought, of which 100 were agreed.

s: To how many sectors were the PLI schemes, launched in 2020 with three sectors, later expanded?
x: The PLI schemes expanded to 14 sectors; disbursals as of March 2025 covered 12 of them.

s: About how much production or sales was generated under the PLI schemes?
x: Production or sales stood at ₹16.5 lakh crore; ₹1.76 lakh crore was investment and ₹21,534 crore the incentives disbursed.

s: What surplus did India's bulk-drug trade reach after a ₹1,930 crore deficit in FY22?
x: The bulk-drug position shifted to a ₹2,280 crore surplus, making India a net exporter.

s: Which of the following was included among the sectors covered by the Production-Linked Incentive schemes?
x: Drones was one of the sectors included among the PLI sectors. Coal mining, tourism and banking were not included in the listed sector set.

s: Which country dominates advanced semiconductor nodes below 5 nm?
x: Taiwan leads advanced semiconductor nodes below 5 nm.

s: In which year was the India Semiconductor Mission established?
x: The India Semiconductor Mission was established in 2021.

s: Which of the following is NOT correct about graduate employability and skilling in India?
o: The German dual system is a model of academia–industry partnership
The National Apprenticeship Promotion Scheme is a model of academia–industry partnership
Over 12 million graduates are produced each year
x: Only 42.6% of graduates are employable, not 46.2%.

s: Which of the following is NOT correct about semiconductors?
o: Silicon, germanium and gallium arsenide are semiconductor materials
N-type doping gives electrons as charge carriers
P-type doping gives electrons as charge carriers
India imports about 90% of the chips it uses
x: P-type material has holes as charge carriers; electrons are the carriers in N-type material.

s: Which Chief Minister is associated with the 55-km Musi stretch within HMDA limits under the Musi Riverfront Development Project?
x: Telangana CM A. Revanth Reddy is associated with the 55-km Musi stretch within HMDA limits.

s: Which of the following Musi Riverfront project pairs is correctly matched?
x: The Gateway of Hyderabad is at Kothwalguda; Gandhi Sarovar is at Bapu Ghat, the Shiva temple at Manchirevula, and the Charminar mosque is heritage restoration.

s: About how much incentive had been disbursed under the PLI schemes as of March 2025?
x: ₹21,534 crore was disbursed; ₹1.76 lakh crore is investment and ₹16.5 lakh crore production/sales.

s: What is the total outlay of the PM E-DRIVE scheme of the Ministry of Heavy Industries?
x:
The printed options did not include the correct answer (₹10,900 crore); it is added as option 5.
The Cabinet approved PM E-DRIVE in September 2024 with an outlay of ₹10,900 crore over two years, of which ₹2,000 crore is for EV charging. ₹10,000 crore (the old key) was the FAME-II outlay; ₹2,000 crore is only the charging component and ₹5,000/₹20,000 crore have no source.

s: Under PM Gati Shakti, the two defence industrial corridors are in which States?
x: India's two defence industrial corridors are in Tamil Nadu and Uttar Pradesh.

s: Which company recorded its highest Q1 execution in 30 years, at 444 MW, in Q1 FY26?
x: Suzlon executed 444 MW; NTPC added 2,716 MW of renewables and Adani Green added 1.6 GW.

s: What is India's cumulative solar-capacity target for 2027?
x: The 2027 cumulative target is 190 GW; about 100 GW was the 2025 module manufacturing capacity.

s: Viability Gap Funding was provided for how much battery storage across 15 States?
x: VGF covered 30 GWh of battery storage across 15 States.

s: How much solar capacity did India install in FY25, up 60% year-on-year?
x: FY25 installations were 24 GW, up 60%; 11 GW was the record Q1 FY26 figure.

s: Which institution reported in August 2025 that solar module manufacturing capacity had reached about 100 GW, raising oversupply concerns?
x: The report was released by SBI Capital Markets (SBICAPS) in August 2025.

s: Where is the International Solar Alliance, launched by India and France at COP21 in 2015, headquartered?
x: The ISA was launched by India and France in 2015 at COP21 and is headquartered at Gurugram.

s: Which of the following pairs (coal-sector tool – role) is correctly matched?
o: Mines Surveillance System – Coal allocation monitoring
x: Uttam concerns coal quality; Koyla Shakti integrates coal, transport, power and state data, and CAMS monitors coal allocation.

s: Under the directions on discom regulatory assets, these assets are capped at what share of the Annual Revenue Requirement?
x: Regulatory assets are capped at 3% of ARR; existing ones are to be cleared in 4 years and new ones in 3 years.

s: Which DISCOM or electricity distribution entity was associated with the first documented case of regulatory assets, amounting to ₹487 crore in 2003-04?
x: Punjab was associated with the first documented case, involving regulatory assets of ₹487 crore in 2003-04. BSES Rajdhani, BSES Yamuna and Tamil Nadu are associated with different regulatory-asset entries.

s: Which of the following is NOT correct about solar-sector schemes and measures?
o: ALMM restricts imports through an approved list of models and manufacturers
PM Surya Ghar creates demand for solar
The PLI for High Efficiency Solar PV Modules has Tranche I of ₹19,500 crore and Tranche II of ₹4,500 crore
x: The tranches are reversed: the ₹24,000 crore PLI allocation comprises Tranche I of ₹4,500 crore and Tranche II of ₹19,500 crore.

s: Which of the following correctly states India’s long-term net-zero target?
x: India’s stated long-term target is to achieve net zero by 2070.

s: Which organisation published the PowerPulse Q1 FY26 report on India's power sector for April–June 2025?
o: Institute for Energy Economics and Financial Analysis (IEEFA)
x: The PowerPulse Q1 FY26 report was published by the Institute for Energy Economics and Financial Analysis (IEEFA). PFC and IREDA are organisations associated with power-sector finance, but they were not identified as the publisher of this report.

s: Which of the following is NOT correct according to the PowerPulse Q1 FY26 report?
o: Peak demand reached 242 GW in June 2025.
The 2032 thermal capacity target was revised to 80 GW from 95 GW.
Renewable additions by listed power companies were 4.6 GW in April–June 2025.
Thermal additions were 1.9 GW in April–June 2025.
x: The 2032 thermal target was raised to 95 GW from 80 GW, not cut.

s: In 2024-25, what was India’s position among the world’s solar electricity producers?
x: India was the third-largest solar electricity producer in 2024-25, after China and the USA. Its generation was 1,08,494 GWh, surpassing Japan’s 96,459 GWh.

s: Which of the following is NOT correct about India's solar industry?
o: Module manufacturing capacity rose from 2 GW in 2014 to about 100 GW in 2025.
Indian modules are 1.5–2 times costlier than Chinese modules.
The 2030 target of 500 GW non-fossil capacity expects 250–280 GW from solar.
India exported about 4 GW of solar modules to China in 2024.
x: India exported about 4 GW of solar modules to the US in 2024, not to China.

s: Coal accounts for about what share of India's electricity generation?
x: Coal provides about 70% of electricity and about 55–60% of energy supply.

s: Which of the following is NOT correct about India's solar sector?
o: Installed solar capacity was 117 GW in September 2025
Effective solar capacity was about 85 GW
Solar power reached parity with coal around 2018
India was third among solar electricity producers in 2024-25
x: Solar reached parity with coal around 2017, not 2018.

s:
Assertion (A): India is to add 97 GW of new coal capacity by 2035.
Reason (R): Nuclear capacity is planned to increase from 8.8 GW to 100 GW by 2047.
o: Both A and R are true, and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true, but R is NOT the correct explanation of A
A is true, but R is false
A is false, but R is true
x: Both the assertion and the reason are true. The 97 GW coal-capacity addition was announced for grid stability, whereas the nuclear-capacity target is a separate planned expansion and does not explain the coal-capacity decision.

s: How much new coal-based capacity does India plan to add by 2035?
x: The plan is 97 GW by 2035: 70 GW in renewable-rich States and 27 GW elsewhere.

s: Which organisation did the CEA task with testing battery storage at coal plants for grid balancing?
x: The CEA tasked NTPC with testing battery storage at coal plants as solar power grows.

s: In which city was the MoU for India's first ship-to-ship LNG bunkering facility at Vizhinjam signed, at India Maritime Week 2025?
x: The MoU between Adani Vizhinjam Port Pvt. Ltd. and BPCL was signed at India Maritime Week 2025 in Mumbai, not Kerala.

s: By which year is India's electricity demand expected to double?
x: Demand is projected to double by 2032, with capacity above 1,000 GW and investment needs above US$500 billion.

s: To which destination did about 97% of India's solar module and cell exports go?
x: As much as 97% of these exports went to the United States, not the EU.

s: What is a 'regulatory asset' in the Supreme Court's directions on DISCOMs?
o: A gap when ARR exceeds ACS, refunded to consumers
The capital asset base of a DISCOM
A gap when ACS exceeds ARR, written off by the State
A gap when ACS exceeds ARR, deferred for later recovery with interest
x: A regulatory asset is the gap when Average Cost of Supply exceeds Annual Revenue Requirement, deferred for later recovery with interest.

s: Till which year is the 97 GW of new coal capacity planned by 2035 meant to run?
x: The plants are meant to run till 2050, not be phased out in 2035; net zero is targeted for 2070.

s: Vizhinjam, site of an LNG bunkering facility, is how far from the East-West international shipping corridor?
x: Vizhinjam is just 10 nautical miles from the East-West shipping corridor.

s: Which Ministry launched the Koyla Shakti Smart Coal Analytics Dashboard on 29 October 2025?
x: The Koyla Shakti dashboard (SCAD) was launched by the Ministry of Coal.

s: Where is India's first ship-to-ship LNG bunkering facility being set up?
x: Adani Vizhinjam Port and BPCL signed an MoU for India's first ship-to-ship LNG bunkering facility at Vizhinjam.

s: What is India's non-fossil power capacity target for 2030?
x: India targets 500 GW of non-fossil capacity by 2030.

s: What was India's installed solar capacity in September 2025?
x: India's installed solar capacity was 117 GW in September 2025 (effective about 85 GW).

s: What nuclear power capacity does India target by 2047?
x: India plans to raise nuclear capacity from 8.8 GW to 100 GW by 2047.

s: In which State is NTPC setting up a green hydrogen hub?
x: NTPC's green hydrogen hub is in Andhra Pradesh.

s: What was India's peak power demand in June 2025, as per the IEEFA PowerPulse report?
x: Peak demand reached 242 GW in June 2025.

s: What fiscal deficit target did Union Budget 2025-26 set?
x: Budget 2025-26 targeted 4.4% of GDP; 4.8% was the 2024-25 revised estimate.

s: How much capital expenditure was set in Union Budget 2025-26?
x: Capex was ₹11.21 lakh crore (about 3.1% of GDP); ₹50.65 lakh crore was total expenditure.

s: Up to what income is no income tax payable in the new regime under Union Budget 2025-26?
x: Income up to ₹12 lakh is tax-free; for salaried people it is ₹12.75 lakh with the ₹75,000 standard deduction.

s: What was the theme of the Economic Survey 2024-25?
x: The Economic Survey 2024-25 focused on deregulation (Ease of Doing Business 2.0).

s:
Consider the following statements about the Economic Survey 2024-25:
1. It was tabled on 31 January 2025.
2. It was prepared by the Department of Expenditure.
3. V. Anantha Nageswaran was the Chief Economic Adviser.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
x: Statements 1 and 3 are correct; the Survey is prepared by the Economic Division of the Department of Economic Affairs.

s: How large is the Urban Challenge Fund announced in Union Budget 2025-26?
x: Budget 2025-26 announced a ₹1 lakh crore Urban Challenge Fund to develop cities as growth hubs.

s: In which State was a Makhana Board announced in Union Budget 2025-26?
x: Budget 2025-26 announced a Makhana Board in Bihar for production, processing and marketing of makhana.

s: Which of the following is NOT correct about India's early Budgets?
o: James Wilson presented British India's first Budget on 7 April 1860
R.K. Shanmukham Chetty presented independent India's first Budget on 26 November 1947
R.K. Shanmukham Chetty presented the first Budget of the Republic
Liaquat Ali Khan presented the 1947-48 Budget of the Interim Government
x: The first Budget of the Republic was presented by John Mathai, not Chetty.

s: Who delivered the longest Union Budget speech by words (18,650 words)?
x: Manmohan Singh's 1991 speech was the longest by words; Sitharaman's 2020 speech was the longest by time (2 h 42 min).

s: Who was the first woman to present the Union Budget (1970-71)?
x: Indira Gandhi, while also Prime Minister, presented the 1970-71 Budget.

s: Who presented the shortest Union Budget, of about 800 words, in 1977?
x: H.M. Patel presented the shortest Budget in 1977, of about 800 words.

s: Who moved the Union Budget presentation time from 5 PM to 11 AM?
x: Yashwant Sinha shifted the presentation time from 5 PM to 11 AM.

s: Where did Budget printing shift from Rashtrapati Bhavan after the 1950 Budget leak?
x: Printing moved to Minto Road after the 1950 leak and to the North Block basement from 1980.

s: In which year did Nirmala Sitharaman replace the Budget briefcase with the Bahi-Khata?
x: The Bahi-Khata replaced the briefcase in 2019.

s: On which occasion did Morarji Desai present the Budget in 1964 and 1968?
o: On the last working day of February
On 1 February, the first Budget day
x: Morarji Desai presented the Budget on 29 February, his birthday, in 1964 and 1968. The other options refer to different Budget traditions or dates and do not describe those two presentations.

s: Who has presented the most Union Budgets (10)?
x: Morarji Desai presented 10 Budgets; Sitharaman and Chidambaram have 9 each.

s: Who moved the Budget date to 1 February and merged the Railway Budget in 2017?
x: Arun Jaitley did both in 2017; Yashwant Sinha changed the time to 11 AM in 1999.

s: Which of the following pairs (Budget record – holder) is correctly matched?
o: Longest speech by time – Nirmala Sitharaman (2020)
Longest speech by words – Nirmala Sitharaman (2020)
Most Budgets by a woman FM – Indira Gandhi
x: Sitharaman's 2020 speech (2 h 42 min) is the longest by time; Manmohan Singh's 1991 speech is longest by words.

s: When was the first paperless Union Budget presented?
x: Nirmala Sitharaman presented the first paperless Budget on 1 February 2021.

s: In which year did the separate Railway Budget begin?
x: A separate Railway Budget began in 1924; it was merged with the Union Budget in 2017.

s: Who presented the first Budget of the Republic of India?
x: John Mathai presented the first Budget of the Republic; Shanmukham Chetty presented independent India's first Budget.

s: Who has presented the most Union Budgets as a woman Finance Minister?
x: Nirmala Sitharaman has presented 9 Budgets, the most by a woman Finance Minister.

s: Which of the following Prime Ministers presented a Union Budget?
o: Jawaharlal Nehru, Charan Singh and Rajiv Gandhi
Lal Bahadur Shastri, Morarji Desai and V.P. Singh
Indira Gandhi, Narasimha Rao and Manmohan Singh
Jawaharlal Nehru, Indira Gandhi and Rajiv Gandhi
x: Jawaharlal Nehru, Indira Gandhi and Rajiv Gandhi presented Budgets while Prime Minister.

s: Where is the Halwa ceremony, which marks the start of Budget printing, held?
x: The Halwa ceremony is held on the ground floor of North Block about 10 days before the Budget.

s: On which date did PM Narendra Modi announce the demonetisation of the ₹500 and ₹1,000 notes?
x: It was announced on the evening of 8 November 2016; the notes ceased to be legal tender from midnight.

s:
Consider the following statements about the GST rollout:
1. GST was launched at midnight of 1 July 2017 in the Central Hall of Parliament.
2. It was based on the 101st Constitutional Amendment.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
x: Both are correct: GST was rolled out at midnight of 1 July 2017 with President Pranab Mukherjee, under the 101st Amendment.

s: What fiscal deficit target did Union Budget 2026-27 set for 2026-27?
x: The 2026-27 target is 4.3% of GDP (₹16.95 lakh crore); 4.4% was the 2025-26 figure.

s: On which date was the Economic Survey 2025-26 tabled?
x: It was tabled on 29 January 2026, two days before the Budget.

s: What real GDP growth did the Economic Survey 2025-26 project for FY27?
x: The Survey projected 6.8–7.2% for FY27 and estimated 7.4% for FY26.

s: Who was the Chief Economic Adviser when the Economic Survey 2025-26 was tabled?
x: V. Anantha Nageswaran was the Chief Economic Adviser for the Economic Survey 2025-26.

s: What real GDP growth did the Economic Survey 2025-26 estimate for FY26?
x: The Economic Survey 2025-26 estimated FY26 real GDP growth at 7.4%.

s: To what level is India's debt-to-GDP ratio to fall under Union Budget 2026-27, from 56.1%?
x: Budget 2026-27 projects the debt-to-GDP ratio to fall from 56.1% to 55.6%.

s: Union Budget 2026–27 allocated how much to BioPharma Shakti over 5 years?
x: BioPharma Shakti got ₹10,000 crore over 5 years, not ₹12,000 crore.

s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the Union Budget 2026–27 semiconductor and electronics measures?
o: The electronics components manufacturing scheme allocation was raised to ₹30,000 crore
India Semiconductor Mission 2.0 includes skill centres
India Semiconductor Mission 2.0 covers indigenous IP and industry-led R&D
India Semiconductor Mission 2.0 covers equipment and raw materials
x: The electronics components scheme allocation was raised to ₹40,000 crore, not ₹30,000 crore.

s: Which State is among the four identified for Rare Earth corridors in Union Budget 2026–27?
x: The four States are Odisha, Kerala, Andhra Pradesh and Tamil Nadu.

s: Union Budget 2026-27 proposed how many new NIPERs?
x: It proposed 3 new NIPERs and an upgrade of the existing 7.

s: To what amount did Union Budget 2026-27 raise the allocation for the Electronics components manufacturing scheme?
x: The electronics components scheme allocation was raised to ₹40,000 crore.

s: How many speciality chemical parks will the Centre help States set up under Union Budget 2026-27?
x: Budget 2026-27 proposes support to States to set up 3 speciality chemical parks.

s: For what are mega textile parks proposed under the textile expansion and employment scheme of Union Budget 2026-27?
x: The scheme proposes mega textile parks for technical textiles; the National Fibre Scheme covers natural, synthetic and advanced fibres.

s: The Union Budget special scheme for legacy industrial clusters aims to rejuvenate how many clusters?
x: The scheme is meant to rejuvenate 200 clusters, not 300.

s: What is the size of the SME Growth Fund announced in Union Budget 2026-27 to create 'champion SMEs'?
x: The SME Growth Fund is ₹10,000 crore; the Atmanirbhar Bharat Fund gets an additional ₹2,000 crore.

s: What is the aim of the National Fibre Scheme announced in Union Budget 2026-27?
o: Self-reliance in natural, synthetic and advanced fibres
x: The National Fibre Scheme aims at self-reliance in natural, synthetic and advanced fibres.

s: Which two entities are to be restructured under Union Budget 2026-27?
x: The Budget proposed restructuring Power Finance Corporation and Rural Electrification Corporation.

s: Which of the following is NOT correct about Union Budget 2026-27 finance-sector proposals?
o: PFC and REC are to be restructured
An Infrastructure Risk Guarantee Fund will give partial credit guarantees to lenders
The SME Growth Fund is ₹10,000 crore
The Atmanirbhar Bharat Fund gets an additional ₹10,000 crore
x: The Atmanirbhar Bharat Fund gets an additional ₹2,000 crore, not ₹10,000 crore.

s: Union Budget 2026–27 allocated how much over 5 years for CCUS technologies?
x: The CCUS allocation is ₹20,000 crore over 5 years; the Budget also announced 7 high-speed rail corridors.

s: To what amount did Union Budget 2026-27 raise capital expenditure?
x: Capex was raised to ₹12.2 lakh crore from ₹11.2 lakh crore.

s: What infrastructure-related institution was proposed to be established in Union Budget 2026–27?
x: The Infrastructure Risk Guarantee Fund was proposed to be established. The other three institutions do not correspond to the announced measure.

s: Which new dedicated freight corridor was proposed in Union Budget 2026-27?
x: The new dedicated freight corridor runs from Dankuni to Surat; the Budget also proposed 20 new National Waterways over 5 years.

s: Which of the following correctly states two transport-related announcements of Union Budget 2026–27?
o: River vessel repair ecosystems at Patna and Kochi; coastal cargo share target of 12% by 2035
River vessel repair ecosystems at Varanasi and Surat; coastal cargo share target of 10% by 2047
River vessel repair ecosystems at Varanasi and Patna; coastal cargo share target of 12% by 2047
River vessel repair ecosystems at Dankuni and Patna; coastal cargo share target of 15% by 2047
x: River vessel repair ecosystems are to be developed at Varanasi and Patna, and the coastal cargo share target is 12% by 2047. The other options change either the locations or the target year and percentage.

s: How many new National Waterways did Union Budget 2026-27 propose over 5 years?
x: It proposed 20 new National Waterways; 7 is the number of high-speed rail corridors.

s: How much did Union Budget 2026-27 provide for each City Economic Region over 5 years?
x: Budget 2026-27 gives ₹5,000 crore over 5 years for each City Economic Region.

s: How many high-speed rail corridors were announced in Union Budget 2026-27?
x: Budget 2026-27 announced 7 high-speed rail corridors.

s: Under Union Budget 2026-27, REITs are to be used to recycle which assets?
x: Budget 2026-27 proposes REITs to recycle the real estate assets of central public sector enterprises.

s: Under the Union Budget 2026–27 tax proposals, from when will the new Income Tax Act come into force?
x: The new Income Tax Act will come into force from April 2026. It will introduce simplified rules and forms designed for common citizens; March 2026 is not the stated commencement period.

s: Under the Union Budget 2026–27 tax proposals, what is the treatment of interest awarded by a Motor Accident Claims Tribunal to a natural person?
o: It is exempt, and TDS on it is removed
It is taxable, and TDS is increased
It is exempt only for non-residents, and TDS is retained
It is taxed as capital gains, and TDS is removed
x: Interest awarded by a Motor Accident Claims Tribunal to a natural person is exempt, and TDS on it is removed. The tempting capital-gains option is incorrect because the proposal specifically concerns exemption and removal of TDS.

s: To which date does Union Budget 2026-27 extend the deadline for revising an income-tax return, from 31 December?
x: The revision deadline moves from 31 December to 31 March with a nominal fee.

s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the Union Budget 2026–27 tax proposals?
o: Updated returns are allowed even after reassessment begins
Such updated returns carry an additional 10% tax
The return-revision deadline moves from 31 December to 31 March
The Foreign Asset Disclosure Scheme is a one-time, 3-month scheme
x: The Foreign Asset Disclosure Scheme runs for 6 months, not 3 months.

s: How are Forms 15G/15H to be filed under Union Budget 2026-27?
x: Forms 15G/15H get single-window filing through depositories; lower/nil TDS certificates get the rules-based automated process.

s: Under the Union Budget 2026–27 proposal on MAT credit, which companies can use the old credit for set-off?
o: All companies, with set-off capped at one-half
Companies moving to the new regime, with set-off capped at one-fourth
Companies remaining in the old regime, with set-off capped at one-fourth
Companies moving to the new regime, with unlimited set-off
x: The old MAT credit can be set off only by companies moving to the new regime, and the set-off is capped at one-fourth. The alternatives incorrectly change the eligible companies or the cap.

s: What is the STT on options premium and exercise under Union Budget 2026-27?
x: STT on options premium and exercise is 0.15%; STT on futures was raised to 0.05%.

s: To what rate is TCS on LRS remittances for education and medical purposes reduced from 5% under Union Budget 2026-27?
x: TCS on LRS for education and medical purposes is now 2%, the same as on foreign tour packages and tendu leaves.

s: What change did Union Budget 2026-27 make to STT on futures?
x: STT on futures was raised from 0.02% to 0.05%; 0.15% applies to options premium and exercise.

s: How are share buybacks to be taxed under Union Budget 2026-27?
o: As capital gains for all shareholders
